import math

EPS = 1e-15


def mse(y_true, y_pred):
    n = len(y_true)
    return sum((t - p) ** 2 for t, p in zip(y_true, y_pred)) / n


def binary_cross_entropy(y_true, y_pred):
    n = len(y_true)
    total = 0.0
    for t, p in zip(y_true, y_pred):
        total += t * math.log(p + EPS) + (1 - t) * math.log(1 - p + EPS)
    return -total / n


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(mse([1, 0, 1], [1, 0, 1]))
    print(binary_cross_entropy([1], [0.999]))
